speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin; have you noticed if the yellowing is spreading to your legs or if your stool or urine has changed color?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding-associated physiologic jaundice (with consideration for breast milk jaundice given the exclusive breastfeeding history and lack of reported pale stools/dark urine).
